review_candidates.title: Core Network Lead
review_candidates.description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead the global build and technical integration of Full MVNO systems. In this role, you will lead a dedicated Build Team responsible for architecting, integrating, testing, and commissioning end-to-end Full MVNO capabilities across global markets. Operating under a Build-to-Run model, you and your team will build new MVNO capabilities and host MNO integrations from the ground up, execute rigorous testing, and hand over stable, operational systems to a dedicated Run team after launch. This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Mobile Core networks across voice, VoLTE, data, and SMS, strong knowledge of telecommunications regulations, and experience leading engineering and QA teams. What You'll Do Lead, mentor and manage a team of around five engineers and QA specialists, owning sprint planning, task allocation and technical reviews across concurrent global rollout streams. Establish engineering best practices, integration templates, automated testing strategy and technical handover standards. Lead technical integrations with host mobile network operators globally, across signalling, packet core, voice and messaging. Own the architecture and setup of Full MVNO core components, from the subscriber database (HSS/HLR) through packet core, signalling routing and messaging platforms. Direct implementation and troubleshooting across the signalling stack, including Diameter and SS7. Own end-to-end service readiness across data, voice and SMS, covering session management, policy enforcement, data routing, VoLTE, legacy circuit-switched voice and international interconnects. Design and validate mobile number portability routing in line with country-specific regulatory frameworks. Own regulatory compliance for each market, covering lawful interception (ETSI ES 201 671 / TS 102 232, HI1/HI2/HI3) and emergency service routing such as e112, 911 and 999. Partner with QA on integration test plans, stress testing and acceptance testing, then drive Operational Readiness Reviews and clean documented handovers to the 24/7 Run team after launch. What You'll Bring 5+ years hands-on in mobile core networks 2+ years leading a team of engineers and/or QA specialists in an agile or delivery-focused environment. Strong working knowledge of both packet core and voice core, including the subscriber database (HSS/HLR), policy and charging, VoLTE and legacy circuit-switched voice. Expertise across the signalling stack, including Diameter, SS7 and SIP. Experience with messaging architecture and SMS routing, including interworking with other operators. Strong delivery mindset across multiple concurrent rollout streams, with clear communication and the ability to produce documentation good enough to hand a system over on. Nice to have Automation experience: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) or automated signalling test frameworks. Hands-on with core MVNO vendors such as Nokia, Ericsson, Mavenir, Oracle Communications, Cisco, Summa Networks, NetNumber or XIUS. Cloud-native or virtualised network functions on AWS, Azure, GCP or private cloud. Degree in telecommunications engineering, computer science, electrical engineering or similar. €76,800 - €110,400 a year At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍 This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world. On-Call Participating in our on-call rotation is a core expectation of this role. It's essential for maintaining 24/7 service reliability across our global operations, ensuring our systems remain resilient and our customers experience uninterrupted service, regardless of time zone or geography. review_candidates.description: Why choose Logicalis? Logicalis lets you experience the digital transformation up close – and to get involved in actively shaping its future. Your expertise makes you a crucial building block here. From pre-sales, sales and consulting to professional service, finance and marketing – we value collaboration highly. A modern, digital workplace and offices located centrally in the biggest German cities (Frankfurt, Berlin, Stuttgart, Munich, Cologne, Dusseldorf) round out what we have to offer. As we are active internationally, you can also get involved in projects on a global scale – a bonus that many of our customers around the world appreciate. We offer speedy decision-making, opportunities for personal development, and a welcoming work environment. Du möchtest Netzwerke nicht nur betreiben, sondern automatisieren? Infrastructure as Code, Automatisierung, SDN und moderne Netzwerkplattformen begeistern dich mehr als manuelle Konfigurationen? Dann werde Teil von Logicalis Connected als Network Engineer (all genders) und entwickle die nächste Generation intelligenter Netzwerkplattformen. Arbeite von jedem Standort innerhalb Deutschlands aus und gestalte gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Teams innovative Netzwerklösungen – überwiegend remote und mit der Flexibilität, die du für deinen Arbeitsalltag brauchst. Deine Aufgaben: Du entwickelst Automatisierungs- und Orchestrierungslösungen für moderne Netzwerkumgebungen. Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Betriebs- und Bereitstellungsprozesse. Du arbeitest mit Software Defined Networking-, Controller- und Orchestrierungsplattformen. Du entwickelst Infrastructure-as-Code-Lösungen für Netzwerk- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen. Du integrierst Netzwerksysteme über APIs in bestehende Kundenumgebungen. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Einführung moderner Betriebs- und Automatisierungskonzepte. Das bringst du mit: Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung in der Netzwerkautomatisierung, Infrastrukturautomatisierung oder softwaregestützten Netzwerkadministration. Du hast fundierte Netzwerkkenntnisse in Routing, Switching und Netzwerkarchitekturen. Du besitzt praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einem der folgenden Themenfelder: Infrastructure as Code; Netzwerkautomatisierung, Software Defined Networking, Intent Based Networking, Cloud Networking, NetOps- oder DevOps-Methodiken Du bringst Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Skript- oder Programmiersprache mit. Du hast Erfahrung mit Automatisierungswerkzeugen, APIs oder vergleichbaren Integrationslösungen. Du arbeitest analytisch, eigenverantwortlich und hast Freude daran, neue Technologien produktiv einzusetzen. Deutsch beherrschst du auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Englisch nutzt du sicher im Projektumfeld. Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit modernen Automatisierungs- und Orchestrierungsplattformen. Kenntnisse in DevOps-Methoden und CI/CD-Prozessen. Erfahrungen in der Umsetzung von Netzwerktransformationsprojekten.
